body:
## Summary
- Shift+drag mixer pan adjusts `Route::pan_width_control` (-1..+1; Equal-Power stereo tracks). Width band + thin W badge when control is present.
- Plain drag still sets azimuth. Default mono-to-stereo strips have no width (1in2out / Stereo Balance); smoke spins a temp 2in2out Equal-Power track.
- `--smoke-pan-width`: full → 0 → full, Dummy exit 0.

## Test plan
- [x] `win_ardour\run-engine-shell.bat --timeout 3 --backend Dummy --smoke-pan-width` → exit 0
- [ ] Interactive: Equal-Power stereo strip → Shift+drag pan → width band + W

Modern D2D + thin Cairo; no gtkmm2; WASAPI shared.
title: Expose strip stereo pan width (Shift+drag pan)
